LESSON: THREE DIMENSION (3-D) OBJECTS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 3.3: Three Dimension (3-D) Objects
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Three Dimension (3-D) Objects, part of Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How are 3-D objects used in the environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

1. Read this lesson on Three Dimension (3-D) Objects together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
